name: dlt-dagster-pipeline-workspace
description: Complete workflow for building domain-organized dlt+Dagster pipeline workspaces. Covers source discovery, REST API pipeline creation, debugging, data validation, incremental loading, custom pagination, Dagster orchestration, CI/CD, and secrets management — all targeting Snowflake (or any dlt destination).
author: Rafael Gomez

skills.name: find-source
skills.description: Find a dlt source for a given API or data provider.

skills.name: create-rest-api-pipeline
skills.description: Create a dlt REST API pipeline with single endpoint, dev limits, and credential setup.

skills.name: debug-pipeline
skills.description: Debug and inspect a dlt pipeline after running it.

skills.name: validate-data
skills.description: Validate schema and data after a successful dlt pipeline load.

skills.name: view-data
skills.description: Query, explore, or view data loaded by a dlt pipeline.

skills.name: adjust-endpoint
skills.description: Adjust a working dlt pipeline for production — remove dev limits, verify pagination, configure incremental loading.

skills.name: new-endpoint
skills.description: Add a new REST API endpoint/resource to an existing dlt pipeline.

skills.name: setup-secrets
skills.description: Safely manage dlt secrets in *.secrets.toml via MCP or CLI.

skills.name: toolkit-dispatch
skills.description: Route users to the right toolkit and skill based on intent.

skills.name: improve-skills
skills.description: Capture session learnings into SKILL.md files.

skills.name: onboard-domain

skills.name: add-dagster-orchestration
skills.description: Wire dlt pipelines into Dagster as software-defined assets with jobs and schedules.

skills.name: setup-ci-cd
skills.description: Create CI/CD pipelines: GitHub Actions, Dockerfile, Dagster Cloud deploy, Dependabot.

skills.name: implement-incremental-loading
skills.description: Add incremental loading with dlt.sources.incremental, merge keys, and config-driven cursors.

skills.name: implement-custom-pagination
skills.description: Custom pagination for APIs using POST-body offsets, page/page_size GET, or non-standard patterns.
